positive.point: Kristaps Porzingis is seen as a brilliant player and a valuable addition to the team, especially when paired with Steph Curry.
De'Anthony Melton appreciates playing with Kristaps Porzingis, highlighting him as a 'matchup nightmare' and expressing a desire to prioritize him in the offseason.
